_readme: Every number on the site. Written by the scripts in scripts/ (see scripts/README.md); do not edit by hand. Map pins and NGO alerts: alerts.json and places.geojson (written by scripts/monitor/coastlens_monitor.py).
aoi: Karachi mangrove coast, Rehri Goth to Port Qasim (67.155304–67.433395°E, 24.671376–24.828817°N, about 28 × 17.5 km)

mangrove_area.source: Global Mangrove Watch v3 extent; area computed by CoastLens within the AOI at 25 m

mangrove_change.source: Global Mangrove Watch v3, 1996 vs 2020 map differencing (includes mapping error)

ndvi_in_mangroves.source: Landsat 8 C2 L2, Nov–Feb cloud-masked median; mean NDVI inside GMW 2020 mangrove extent

s1_vh_in_mangroves.source: Sentinel-1 GRD VH (DESCENDING), Nov–Feb median, 30 m focal median; mean dB inside GMW 2020 mangrove extent

nisar.source: NISAR L2 GCOV track 164 descending, frame 76, on a 20 m grid (provisional products). Mean of linear power inside Global Mangrove Watch v4.1 2025 mangroves; water = Sentinel-2 MNDWI mask.

backscatter.source: NISAR L2 GCOV, track 164, frequencyB grid (80 m); zone mean of linear power, in dB

series.qc: suspect acquisition: uniform near-zero coherence in all zones (sensor/processing issue, not landscape change)

coherence.source: NISAR L2 GUNW, track 164, HH coherence magnitude, 80 m grid; zone mean

suspect acquisition: uniform near-zero coherence in all zones (sensor/processing issue, not landscape change)

nisar_timeseries.zones: mangrove = GMW 2020 (>50% of cell); water = Sentinel-2 MNDWI water (>90%); land = neither (<10% of each)

nisar_pixel.source: NISAR L2 GCOV track 164, 27 dates 20251121-20261023 (QC-suspect dates removed), HV and HH per pixel on a 20 m grid after a 3x3 speckle filter

mode_offset.what: Median over each surface of (a dual-pol pass, dB) minus (the mean of its two quad-pol neighbours, averaged in linear power). quad_control_db is the same measure for quad-pol passes between two quad-pol passes and should be near zero. Measured on the unfiltered 20 m stack.
mode_offset.handling: Not corrected: the offset differs by surface, so one constant would not fit. Yearly means, the AI features, the land-cover rules and the structural-vs-moisture windows use quad-pol passes only. The HV trend uses every pass, relative to the forest median of the same pass, with the imaging mode as a covariate.

classes.rules_db: water/mudflat: HV < -20.5; built-up: HH > -3.5 or HV-HH < -10 or HV > -10.5; mangrove: HV >= -19, HV-HH >= -8 and 100 m HV texture < 1.3 dB; other land: the rest

agreement.tested_on: pixels GMW is sure about (over 90% or under 10% mangrove); mixed edge pixels are left out

ai.model: Random Forest (150 trees) on 10 NISAR-only features per 20 m pixel
ai.trained_on: Global Mangrove Watch v4.1 2025 labels (pixels clearly mangrove or clearly not)
ai.validation: 2 km checkerboard blocks: trained on half the map, tested on the other half, and swapped

held_out_accuracy.tested_on: pixels GMW is sure about (over 90% or under 10% mangrove); mixed edge pixels are left out

threshold_rules_accuracy_same_pixels.tested_on: pixels GMW is sure about (over 90% or under 10% mangrove); mixed edge pixels are left out

ai.published_map: A second model trained on every sure pixel in the box (not the held-out models), mangrove = probability >= 0.5

trend.unit: dB per year, relative to the forest median on each date
trend.forest_mask: Global Mangrove Watch v4.1 2025, at least half of the 20 m pixel (independent of the tested year)
trend.model: per pixel: relative HV = a + b*time + m*(dual-pol pass) + c*tide
trend.rule: weakening = slope <= -1 dB/yr AND |t| >= 2; strengthening likewise; else steady. t = slope / standard error, deflated for lag-1 autocorrelation of the residuals (n_eff = n(1-r)/(1+r)). Not corrected for season or for testing many pixels.

by_chance.method: 20 runs with the order of the passes shuffled (same shuffle for all pixels), refitted, same rule. Measures random noise only: a shuffle also destroys any seasonal curve.

mask_change.old_mask: AI mangrove probability >= 0.5 (built from the same year of HV)

tide.source: docs/tide_at_pass.csv (predicted tide height at each pass)

trend.same_season_comparison: pending: needs Nov-Dec 2026 quad-pol passes to compare with Nov-Dec 2025
trend.caveat: One year of data: this ranks patches against the rest of the forest, and season-dependent effects (tidal flooding, leaf flush, soil moisture) can differ between patches. It is not yet a multi-year trend.

change_type.modes: quad-pol passes only in both windows; averaged and smoothed in linear power
change_type.rule: changed if |dHV| or |dHH| >= 2 dB (60 m smoothed); structural if |dHV - dHH| >= 1.5 dB and |dHV| >= 2 dB (cross-pol volume echo moved much more than co-pol = canopy changed); otherwise moisture (both moved together = wetter/drier ground or tidal flooding)
change_type.caveat: Early and late windows are 8 to 11 months apart and not the same season, so moisture changes are expected. Structural pixels are candidates for field checks, not confirmed loss.

sensor_comparison.what: How well each sensor alone separates mangrove from non-mangrove on the same 20 m pixels (AUC: 0.5 = coin flip, 1.0 = perfect). Labels: pixels that GMW v4.1 2025 calls clearly mangrove (>90%) or clearly not (<10%).
sensor_comparison.caveat: GMW is itself built from Landsat and ALOS, so this comparison is tilted in favour of the older sensors. NISAR still has to match it without any optical input.

results.sensor: NISAR AI model (10 radar features, held-out blocks)

gmw_timeseries.source: Global Mangrove Watch v4.1.12 (Aberystwyth University / JAXA, July 2026), annual extent from Landsat, Sentinel-2 and JAXA L-band; area computed by CoastLens within the AOI
gmw_timeseries.note: km2 is the plain mapped area (matches the GMW website's custom-area widget within ~1%); km2_corrected applies GMW's global accuracy correction (x0.9775) used in their country totals. GMW reports ~93% accuracy globally; local accuracy varies.

decline_zones.source: Global Mangrove Watch v4.1.12 annual extent 1985-2025 (Zenodo 21346457); zones found by CoastLens
decline_zones.method: ~245 m cells; a cell is 'steadily declining' if after its peak year (<= 2018) it lost >= 40% of its peak mangrove, its yearly area mostly falls (Kendall tau <= -0.5) and it has not recovered in the last 5 years. Touching cells are joined into zones; zones that lost < 0.1 km2 are dropped.

zone_history.note: Mean value inside each GMW decline zone and inside stable reference forest (GMW v3 mangrove in both 1996 and 2020). 'year' = the year the dry season ends (Nov-Feb). NDVI: Landsat 5/7/8/9; ALOS HV: JAXA PALSAR/PALSAR-2 yearly mosaics (dB); S1 VH: Sentinel-1 GRD descending (dB).
